# questions

Question output must be an explicit questions array, which may be empty, or structured nominations. Each nomination must include class, evidence, and consequence. The class field is closed to: invalidated-decision, missing-material-decision, material-underdetermination, dod-hole, unsafe-irreversible. Call autopilot_submit_resolution when the payload is ready. If it returns RETRY, correct the reported diagnostic and call autopilot_submit_resolution again in this same session. Only ACCEPT terminalizes. Do not return the payload as assistant prose or markdown.
